_approach: 2020s sped-up amen over garage (the jungle x garage crossover that runs alongside the PinkPantheress-era revival): the classic 2-step kick/clap skeleton stays intact and the backbeat still anchors 2 and 4, but a rapid chopped-amen texture — paired ghost 'kick' and 'snare' hits at double time, the way jungle producers slice and rearrange the break — is threaded through the rim and a second percussion voice, echoing how sped-up breaks get dropped into contemporary garage sets. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
